about: I'm Maryna, a video and audio editor based in Poznań, Poland, with 6 years of editing in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects and Photoshop.
I take your raw footage, audio and graphics and shape them into videos that sound clean, look consistent and carry your brand's personality.
Communication is at the core of how I work. I work in English, Polish, Ukrainian and Russian.
